description: This file contains the implementation of the AdministrationService interface in the OpenMRS platform. It provides methods to manage global properties, system information, locales, implementation IDs, and other administrative functions within the OpenMRS medical record system. The class interacts with the database through DAO, handles global property events, and incorporates caching for locale searches.

classes.name: AdministrationServiceImpl
classes.description: Default implementation of the AdministrationService interface, providing core functions for managing global properties, system information, and localization within OpenMRS.

methods.name: getSystemVariables
methods.description: Returns a sorted map of system variables, including host, version, database info, and operating system details.

methods.name: getGlobalProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a global property by name, throws exception if view privileges are insufficient.

methods.name: setGlobalProperty
methods.description: Creates or updates a global property with the specified name and value.

methods.name: updateGlobalProperty
methods.description: Updates an existing global property after privilege verification.

methods.name: getAllGlobalProperties
methods.description: Returns all global properties, filtered by view privileges.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertiesByPrefix
methods.description: Retrieves global properties whose names start with the specified prefix.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertiesBySuffix
methods.description: Retrieves global properties whose names end with the specified suffix.

methods.name: purgeGlobalProperty
methods.description: Deletes a global property after verifying delete privileges.

methods.name: saveGlobalProperty
methods.description: Persists a global property, includes validation and privilege checks.

methods.name: saveGlobalProperties
methods.description: Saves a list of global properties; invoked within cache evictions.

methods.name: getAllowedLocales
methods.description: Returns the list of locales allowed in the system, initializing lazily.

methods.name: getPresentationLocales
methods.description: Returns a set of locales used for presentation, considering allowed locales.

methods.name: globalPropertyChanged
methods.description: Listener method invoked when a global property changes, resets presentation locale cache.
